description_en: Enables the HTTPS protocol. Before enabling HTTPS, ensure that you have purchased client nodes
description_zh: 开启HTTPS协议。开启前请确保已购买协调节点
name: OpenHttps

parameters.description_en: A unique token generated by the client to guarantee the idempotence of the request. The value must be unique among different requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length.
parameters.description_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。
